title: Micro Onboard: Priority Map & Skills Gateway
body:
Purpose:
Quick, role-agnostic micro-onboarding template intended for hires joining hybrid pods (contractors, temp hires, or FT transfer-ins). Focus: get to first meaningful contribution in 14 calendar days while capturing the right signals for full-role ramp decisions.

Intended audience:
- People Ops partners running fast onboards
- Hiring managers who need a concise pack for early weeks
- Mentors/peers assigned to day-zero and week-one activities

How to use this doc (notes to self):
- Copy the template into a candidate-specific sheet and fill the gateway checkpoints before day 1.
- Mark MUST vs NICE on each activity to prioritize for <14d hires.
- Use the "Skills Gateway" signals at day 7 to decide whether to extend mentorship or escalate to hiring manager for a bespoke plan.

Micro Onboard Pillars (why these cover early risk):
1) Context: surface-level product, repo map, immediate team rituals. Reduces signal noise for first PR.
2) First-impact task: scoped, testable work that is routed to the smallest safe surface area.
3) Mentor-led learning loops: 2x short syncs + async check-ins to unblock quickly.
4) Early signals: acceptance criteria for soft and technical skills to inform next 30/90 plan.

14-Day Plan (priority-first view)
DAY 0 (pre-boarding) - MUST
- Send welcome pack: calendar invites + one-pager "what matters in week 1" (owner: People Ops).
- Provision: access request ticket created (SRE), Slack, code repo read, docs.
- Micro-survey: ask hire's preferred working hours + timezone blockers.

DAY 1 - MUST
- 30-min intro with manager (mission, success metrics for first 30 days).
- 45-min buddy walkthrough of repository and local dev flow (buddy = mentor).
- Create first-issue: "intro task" with clear acceptance criteria.

DAYS 2-3 - MUST
- Complete sanity checklist: run tests locally, lint, dev server up.
- Small doc task: edit README to fix a typo or add missing step (quick PR).
- Mentor async notes: record a 3–5 minute Loom for the repo entry points.

DAYS 4-7 - MUST -> NICE
- Ship first-impact PR (target: small feature / bug / infra fix).  
- Short demo: 15-min show-and-tell to mentor + product rep.
- Gateway check at day 7: review signals (see Skills Gateway below). If red flags, escalate.

DAYS 8-14 - NICE
- Tackle second scoped task that surfaces service integration or infra touches.
- Join cross-team syncs to meet adjacent owners.
- Draft a short retrospective with mentor notes: what went well, where to focus in next 30 days.

Skills Gateway (day 7 signal rubric) - QUICK PASS/GO/ESCALATE
- Technical: Can run local dev + produce a PR with tests & passing CI? (PASS=Yes; GO=Yes + needs style tweaks; ESCALATE=No)
- Communication: Does the hire post clear async updates in channel and respond to review comments within 24h?
- Autonomy: Can they find basic docs and triage a small bug independently?
- Culture fit/drive: Engages with team rituals, asks clarifying Qs, shows curiosity.
- Manager note: any access or environment blockers preventing signal collection = escalate to People Ops / SRE.

Decision outcomes (after gateway):
- PASS -> proceed to 30-day plan (hand off to manager for standard 30/60 planning).
- GO -> extend mentorship with 1:1 coaching focus for next 2 weeks (mentor-led tasks).
- ESCALATE -> schedule manager + People Ops sync; consider role fit triggers and remedial plan.

Mentor Playbook (short)
- Day 0 prep: skim candidate profile and add 3 quick wins the hire can own.
- Daily async: 10–15 min check-in notes pushed to the onboarding thread.
- Day 7 formal review: fill quick gateway checklist and one-sentence recommendation.

Quick Templates (copy-paste)
- Welcome subject: "Welcome to Redwood — your Week 1 at-a-glance"
- First-issue title: "[FIRST TASK] Intro: fix README + run tests locally"
- Gateway prompt to manager: "Day7: PASS/GO/ESCALATE? notes: <one-liner>"

Signals we track (suggested minimum)
- PR count in first 14 days (numeric), PR lead time (hrs), CI success on first PR (bool), number of doc updates, mentor satisfaction (scale 1–5), blocker count opened and resolved.

Risks & mitigations (brainstorm):
- Risk: environment/access delays -> Mitigate: ship a "no-code" docs-first first task that can be done without infra.
- Risk: mismatch in expectation -> Mitigate: manager sets clear 30-day success metrics on day 1.
- Risk: hire bandwidth/time-zone mismatch -> Mitigate: compress async updates + schedule overlapping hours front-loaded.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- Add role-specific micro task library for infra, product, SRE, sales-engineering by end of Q2.
- Decide if contractors get same gateway cadence or a shorter 7-day-only version.
- Connect with Growth team to map basic GTM contexts for non-engineering hires.

Links & quick references:
- Onboarding Confluence: /onboarding/micro-gateway (see linked artifact above)
- Access request template: JIRA-OPS-1123
- Example PR used as a model: github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-examples/pull/21

Notes / tone guidance for hiring managers (two lines):
- Keep the first-impact task tiny and observable — we want to see flow not slow-mo architecture tests.
- Prioritize removing blockers early; early friction kills momentum faster than task difficulty.

Appendix: compact checklist (copy to checklist tool)
- Pre-boarding: access ticket, welcome note, calendar invites.
- Day 1: manager intro, buddy walkthrough, create first-issue.
- Day 7: gateway rubric completed, decision logged.
- Day 14: second PR shipped, mentorship retrospective recorded.

End of doc — quick edit log:
- 2025-02-12 A.Patel initial draft
- 2025-03-01 D.Morales added mentor playbook + signals

(Informal style intentionally — this doc is a working template; will polish into a full Confluence page once validated by two pilot pods.)
